title: Multi-Step Funnel Stencil
conversionGoal: Guide the visitor through staged qualification, routing, and completion without forcing all decisions onto a single page.
notes: Normalized from landing, feature, proof, form, FAQ, and routing patterns across the source templates.
The funnel is intentionally step-driven rather than visually embellished.
Each page represents a clear decision or commitment boundary in the flow.

sources.notes: Confirmed staged process communication and step-oriented marketing structure.
Added sequential content and step-like reveal patterns that normalize into structured progression.
Expanded reusable step, FAQ, proof, and CTA building blocks.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: Introduce the staged flow and invite the visitor into step one.

sections.name: FeatureGrid
sections.purpose: Explain the paths or outcomes inside the flow.

sections.name: QualificationForm
sections.purpose: Collect the information needed to route the visitor correctly.

sections.name: FAQSection
sections.purpose: Handle uncertainty before the next route is chosen.

sections.name: CTASection
sections.purpose: Drive the visitor into the next step.

sections.name: NextStepPanel
sections.purpose: Explain what route or action comes next in the flow.

sections.name: ConfirmationPanel
sections.purpose: Confirm the end of the flow and clarify follow-up.

pages.name: EntryPage
pages.goal: Introduce the staged flow and earn the first click.

pages.name: QualificationPage
pages.goal: Gather the details needed to decide the right path.

pages.name: OfferPage
pages.goal: Resolve friction and route the visitor to the correct outcome.
